statistic: Net voted Exchequer supply grant ceilings from Dáil Revised Estimates resolution; NOT gross spending, actual expenditure or totals including SIF/NTF.
scope: 37 numbered Votes explicitly contained in the 25 March 2026 Dáil resolution. Not all votes are included in this resolution; no residual or full budget share is computed.

votes.title: President's Establishment
votes.description: Staff and running costs of the President's Establishment and specified grants.
votes.limit: The sum covers an office's approved Exchequer supply, not the complete national cost of the presidency.

votes.title: Department of the Taoiseach
votes.description: Central government support services administered by the Department of the Taoiseach, along with specified grants.
votes.limit: This vote is not the combined running cost of all government departments.

votes.title: Office of the Attorney General
votes.description: Professional legal services provided to the Government and certain grants administered through the Attorney General's Office.
votes.limit: Legal aid, courts and prosecution budgets sit in other Votes.

votes.title: Central Statistics Office
votes.description: The official statistics office and the work required to collect, compile and publish national statistics.
votes.limit: A statistical programme can also be supported by other bodies; the supply grant is an institutional amount.

votes.title: Office of the Director of Public Prosecutions
votes.description: The office responsible for prosecution decisions and related public-prosecution operations.
votes.limit: A prosecution vote is distinct from Garda operations, courts and prison services.

votes.title: Office of the Chief State Solicitor
votes.description: The legal-service costs and salaries of the Office of the Chief State Solicitor.
votes.limit: This does not encompass every public-sector legal service or legal-aid programme.

votes.title: Office of the Minister for Finance
votes.description: Finance department administration, the Paymaster-General's Office, relevant services and certain grants.
votes.limit: The figure does not represent Ireland's national debt, debt interest or total tax revenue.

votes.title: Office of the Comptroller and Auditor General
votes.description: The independently mandated State auditor's office and its operational expenditure.
votes.limit: The audit office's voted allocation is not a measure of money saved or recovered from public audit.

votes.title: Office of the Revenue Commissioners
votes.description: The administration of taxation, customs and related services delivered by Revenue.
votes.limit: This is the cost authorised for Revenue's services, not the amount of tax Revenue collects.

votes.title: Tax Appeals Commission
votes.description: The independent Tax Appeals Commission and its work on eligible appeals against tax assessments.
votes.limit: It should not be conflated with tax refunds, taxes in dispute or total litigation costs.

votes.title: Office of Public Works
votes.description: The Office of Public Works, property functions, administered services and certain government grants.
votes.limit: Projects and property-management services may cross departmental boundaries; do not allocate the full Vote to any single project.

votes.title: Tailte Éireann
votes.description: State land and property mapping, surveying and registration functions, together with associated services.
votes.limit: The figure is the supply grant and excludes a separately authorised use of capital carryover.

votes.title: Garda Síochána
votes.description: The Garda organisation's salaries, pension-related provision, operational services and associated grants.
votes.limit: Separate capital carryover is authorised; this is a voted net supply amount and not interchangeable with all Garda gross expenditure.

votes.title: Prisons
votes.description: The Irish Prison Service, detention facilities and related services and grants.
votes.limit: This figure is not the cost of the entire criminal justice system and should not be added to broader sector amounts.

votes.title: Courts Service
votes.description: The Courts Service and relevant costs of Irish courts and associated services funded through the Vote.
votes.limit: Certain court-related salaries are Central Fund charges, outside this Vote; a separate capital carryover is also authorised.

votes.title: An Coimisiún Toghcháin
votes.description: The Electoral Commission's institutional and electoral-administration functions.
votes.limit: Election-specific costs can be carried by other public bodies, so this is not a nationwide cost-per-election estimate.

votes.title: Justice, Home Affairs and Migration
votes.description: The Justice Department, associated services, grants and Probation Service staff provision.
votes.limit: The wider justice-sector total also includes Garda, prisons, courts and other bodies recorded under separate Votes.

votes.title: Irish Human Rights and Equality Commission
votes.description: Human rights and equality oversight functions and specified grants.
votes.limit: An independent commission's supply grant is not equal to all government spending on equality.

votes.title: International Co-operation
votes.description: Certain Official Development Assistance, development-related international contributions and associated administration.
votes.limit: A voted international-cooperation allocation is not automatically equal to the State's full overseas-aid total.

votes.title: Foreign Affairs and Trade
votes.description: Diplomatic and foreign-affairs functions, international subscriptions and grants.
votes.limit: The separate International Co-operation Vote provides additional functions, but neither alone represents every international payment.

votes.title: Climate, Energy and the Environment
votes.description: The climate, energy and environment department's services, grants and programme administration.
votes.limit: Capital carryover has a separate authorisation and programmes may be delivered by other departments too.

votes.title: Agriculture, Food and the Marine
votes.description: Agricultural, food and marine programmes, departmental services, grants and subsidies.
votes.limit: This net Vote excludes a separate authorised use of unspent capital appropriations and is not total agricultural-sector output.

votes.title: Transport
votes.description: The Department of Transport's services, grants and selected transport and infrastructure responsibilities.
votes.limit: The total is a voted net supply grant, not the cost of every road, rail and bus service or a confirmed outturn.

votes.title: Enterprise, Tourism and Employment
votes.description: Enterprise, tourism and employment services, departmental administration, subsidies and grants.
votes.limit: Some grants or capital measures may be carried forward separately; these are not private-enterprise revenues.

votes.title: Culture, Communications and Sport
votes.description: Cultural, communications and sport responsibilities, public subsidies and departmental grants.
votes.limit: This Vote spans different programmes and should not be labelled solely as broadcasting or sport funding.

votes.title: Housing, Local Government and Heritage
votes.description: The Housing Department's grants, local authority supports, housing, water-related services and heritage functions.
votes.limit: This Vote covers multiple purposes; it is not solely housing construction and is different from the gross sector total.

votes.title: Army Pensions
votes.description: Retired pay, pensions, compensation and certain allowances connected with the Defence Forces.
votes.limit: This is a standalone pension Vote and should not be counted within Defence's operating Vote again.

votes.title: Defence
votes.description: The Defence Forces' pay and operations, Defence Department administration and certain grants.
votes.limit: Army pensions have a separate Vote, and the Defence Vote is not exclusively equipment procurement.

votes.title: Social Protection
votes.description: Social Protection administration, income supports and transfers including provision for the Social Insurance Fund.
votes.limit: This is the Exchequer net supply grant. It does NOT equal the gross €28.9bn social protection sector total, which includes Social Insurance Fund spending.

votes.title: Health
votes.description: The Health Department's services, grants to the HSE and other specified public health spending.
votes.limit: This Vote is an Exchequer supply grant; it is different from the gross health-sector chart and from HSE activity alone.

votes.title: Uisce Éireann
votes.description: Exchequer grant funding provided to Uisce Éireann for water services.
votes.limit: This is a separate Vote from Housing, Local Government and Heritage; avoid counting transfers twice in any final spending tree.

votes.title: Children, Disability and Equality
votes.description: The Children, Disability and Equality Department's services, welfare and childcare-related grants and programmes.
votes.limit: This Vote's 2026 supply grant is distinct from disability income-support payments funded through Social Protection.

votes.title: Policing and Community Safety Authority
votes.description: The statutory policing and community safety oversight authority and specified grants.
votes.limit: This independent oversight body's supply is separate from the Garda Síochána Vote.

votes.title: Rural and Community Development and the Gaeltacht
votes.description: Rural and community development programmes, Gaeltacht services and associated grants.
votes.limit: This Vote includes community and rural programmes, not just one village regeneration scheme; capital carryover is authorised separately.

votes.title: Data Protection Commission
votes.description: The Data Protection Commission's enforcement, supervision and administrative responsibilities.
votes.limit: Its budget is an institutional supply grant, not revenue collected from enforcement fines.

votes.title: Further and Higher Education, Research, Innovation and Science
votes.description: Further and higher education, research, science and innovation services, including certain grants.
votes.limit: This is separate from the schools department and should not be put under the schools-only Education sector without compatible mapping.

votes.title: Fiosrú
votes.description: The independent policing misconduct and accountability body, Fiosrú, and its salaries and operating expenses.
votes.limit: The Vote is one institutional estimate, not a measure of all police complaints or their outcomes.
